patch_description:
This version retains the strong threshold-based formulation, which directly models the minimax KVPR constraint as a two-dimensional packing problem. It improves construction diversity by using four deterministic item orderings and combines tight best-fit packing with a final local-search polish.

The polish phase evaluates relocations and swaps using the complete sorted KVPR profile, so it minimizes the maximum pressure first and improves secondary GPU pressures only when the primary objective is unchanged. Model demand and size are precomputed once, avoiding repeated attribute access and repeated demand calculations.
